description: The everyday GPT-6-Astra posture: effort `high`, planning at `xhigh`, compaction at 200K to stay on the near side of the 272K surcharge threshold. `model_reasoning_effort` is set explicitly because leaving it unset yields `none`, the one effort Astra rejects. This variant owns AGENTS.md and deliberately does not own config.toml: the ChatGPT desktop app rewrites that file from scratch on every launch, and it is where browser use is registered. On a machine with the app, apply the posture through bin/astra instead.
